verdicts.reason: A reads sensibly left to right (can, then headline, body copy, CTA), but there's a big empty strip on the left, the can is small, 'WEEKEND ONLY' is shrunk into the tiny legal line, and the CTA is jammed against the right edge on top of the cropped peach circle.
